name: Funeral Benefit (MBOCWWB)
benefit: 1. Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹5,000/- shall be given to nominees or dependents of deceased registered construction workers, towards funeral expenses.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a legal nominee or dependent of deceased worker.
   1. The deceased worker should have been a resident of Meghalaya.
   1. The deceased worker should have been engaged in any building or other construction work.
   1. The deceased worker should have been registered under the Meghalaya Building &amp; Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
   1. The financial assistance shall be given to nominees or dependents of deceased registered workers, towards funeral expenses.
